SELECT ta.structure_type, any_value ( tmp.gross_weight ) gross_weight, sum( mbtnmps.need_quantity * tmp.gross_weight ) thisMonthPutPart, sum( ta.gross_weight * ta.produced_quantity ) thisMonthPutPart FROM mes_building_task_need_machine_part_scheduling mbtnmps LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part tmp ON tmp.id = mbtnmps.product_id AND tmp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_task mbt ON mbt.id = mbtnmps.task_id AND mbt.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = mbt.product_id AND ta.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE mbtnmps.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ta.structure_type IS NOT NULL
AND mbt.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(mbt.ask_complete_time, '%Y%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(#{yearMonth} / 1000), '%Y%m')
GROUP BY ta.structure_type

SELECT ta.structure_type, sum( ta.gross_weight * mbc.quantity ) thisMonthFinishProduct FROM mes_building_complete mbc LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = mbc.product_id AND ta.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE mbc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ta.structure_type IS NOT NULL
AND mbc.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(mbc.create_time, '%Y%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(#{yearMonth} / 1000), '%Y%m')
GROUP BY ta.structure_type

SELECT ta.structure_type, cp.id AS project_id, any_value ( tmp.gross_weight ) gross_weight, sum( mbtnmps.need_quantity * tmp.gross_weight ) thisMonthPutPart, sum( ta.gross_weight * ta.produced_quantity ) thisMonthPutPart FROM mes_building_task_need_machine_part_scheduling mbtnmps LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part tmp ON tmp.id = mbtnmps.product_id AND tmp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_task mbt ON mbt.id = mbtnmps.task_id AND mbt.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = mbt.product_id AND ta.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = mbtnmps.project_id WHERE mbtnmps.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ta.structure_type IS NOT NULL
AND mbt.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(mbt.ask_complete_time, '%Y%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(#{yearMonth} / 1000), '%Y%m')
GROUP BY ta.structure_type, cp.id

SELECT ta.structure_type, cp.id AS project_id, sum( ta.gross_weight * mbc.quantity ) thisMonthFinishProduct FROM mes_building_complete mbc LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = mbc.product_id AND ta.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = mbc.project_id WHERE mbc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ta.structure_type IS NOT NULL
AND mbc.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(mbc.create_time, '%Y%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(#{yearMonth} / 1000), '%Y%m')
GROUP BY ta.structure_type, cp.id

SELECT mbtp.task_id AS taskId, ta.structure_type AS structureType, mbtp.product_id AS productId, process.id AS processId, process.NAME AS processTypeName, task_quantity taskQuantity, sum( report.quantity ) completeQuantity, mbtp.sequence, ta.gross_weight grossWeight FROM mes_building_task_process mbtp LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report report ON report.task_process_id = mbtp.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON process.id = mbtp.process_id LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = mbtp.product_id AND ta.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE mbtp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbtp.task_type_enum = 2 AND mbtp.complete_quantity > 0 AND ta.structure_type IS NOT NULL AND mbtp.complete_time IS NULL
AND mbtp.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(report.create_time, '%Y%m' ) >= DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(#{yearMonth} / 1000), '%Y%m')
GROUP BY mbtp.id ORDER BY mbtp.task_id, mbtp.sequence DESC

SELECT mbtp.task_id AS taskId, ta.structure_type AS structureType, mbtp.product_id AS productId, process.id AS processId, process.NAME AS processTypeName, task_quantity taskQuantity, sum( report.quantity ) completeQuantity, mbtp.sequence, ta.gross_weight grossWeight FROM mes_building_task_process mbtp LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report report ON report.task_process_id = mbtp.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON process.id = mbtp.process_id LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = mbtp.product_id AND ta.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE mbtp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbtp.task_type_enum = 2 AND mbtp.complete_quantity > 0 AND ta.structure_type IS NOT NULL AND mbtp.complete_time IS NULL
AND mbtp.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(report.create_time, '%Y%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(#{yearMonth} / 1000), '%Y%m')
GROUP BY mbtp.id ORDER BY mbtp.task_id, mbtp.sequence DESC

SELECT ta.structure_type, sum((mbtp.task_quantity - mbtp.complete_quantity) * ta.gross_weight ) beginHalfProduct FROM mes_building_task_process mbtp LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = mbtp.product_id AND ta.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ta.structure_type IS NOT NULL WHERE mbtp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbtp.task_type_enum = 2 AND mbtp.complete_time IS NULL GROUP BY ta.structure_type
